pr_title: communicator/ssh: Fix crash with SSH bastion port
pr_body:
The connection block schema defines the `bastion_port` argument as a number, but we were incorrectly trying to convert it from a string. This commit fixes that by attempting to convert the `cty.Number` to the `int` result type, returning the error on failure.

An alternative approach would be to change the `bastion_port` argument in the schema to be a string, matching the `port` argument. I'm less sure about the secondary effects of that change, though.

Fixes #28658

issue_context.title: Crash when using bastion_port
issue_context.body:

### Terraform Configuration Files

```
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 0.15.3"
  required_providers {
    null = {
      source  = "hashicorp/null"
      version = ">=2.1.2"
    }
  }
}

resource "null_resource" "attach_volume" {
  count       = 3

  connection {
    bastion_host        = "bastion.example.org"
    bastion_port        = "20022"
    bastion_user        = "aaa"
    host                = "127.0.0.1"
    user                = "root"
    password            = "hello_world"
  }

  provisioner "file" {
    content     = "Hello world"
    destination = "/tmp/test.txt"

}
```

review_comments:
An interesting consequence of this approach is that if we were to change the type of this `BastionPort` field to be `uint16` then I believe `gocty` will also automatically produce a range error if the value is outside of the expected range of port numbers.

I'm not meaning to say "you should do this" here, but more just an FYI in case you want to give it a try and see what the implications are. Fine to leave that for another layer to validate too, though.
That's a neat idea, I hadn't considered it! Thanks.
